name: AcBel Polytech Inc.
summary: AcBel Polytech Inc. engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of electronic components in Mainland China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Power Supply Department and Hardware parts and other segments. The company offers industrial PSUs, adapters, medical PSUs, telecom PSUs, and EV power solutions, optimization process solution as well as operates solar farms. It also provide smart green energy services. Its products are used in personal computers, smart home applications, smartphones, servers, networking, and medical equipment.
